title: Pact Worlds Observances
citation: Starfinder Player Core, “A Year on Absalom Station.”

events.name: 31 Days of Deals
events.description: AbadarCorp's month-long commercial campaign fills Abadius with deals.

events.name: The Freegames
events.description: A 13-day sports festival showcases competitions from across the Pact Worlds; the source does not specify its start date.

events.name: Eternal Fondness
events.description: Throughout Calistril, residents leave flowers for the beloved and blades or other sharp objects for the loathed.

events.name: Flowering Moon
events.description: A festival honoring Iwalewa begins on Gozran's first new moon; its exact date varies and is not specified.

events.name: Cosmic Birthday
events.description: An early-Desnus observance remembering the Newborn's birth in 324 AG; no exact day is given.

events.name: Catharsis
events.description: A Sarenith celebration of Shelyn and Zon-Kuthon's reconciliation; the source does not specify the anniversary date.

events.name: Remembrance Day
events.description: Held on the last Seventhday of Erastus, mourning Golarion and other losses of the Gap and later conflicts.

events.name: Defrag Day
events.description: On 26 Rova, Aballon's anacites go dormant for a day of rest; the Pact Worlds adopted it as a broader day off.

events.name: Picklefest
events.description: A grassroots goblin festival with extreme-flavor potlucks, junk races, and swap meets; no fixed date is specified.

events.name: Mother May I?
events.description: A late-Lamashan celebration honoring Lamashtu, with monster mazes, costumes, unusual food, and parties.

events.name: Reunion
events.description: An Akitonian community holiday centered on pooled messages, gifts, and a shared meal; local dates vary.

events.name: First Choices
events.description: A shirren-innovated holiday featuring the exchange and show-and-tell of personally meaningful creations; no fixed date is specified.

events.name: Newspark
events.description: An android abolitionist tradition of parades, music, and gifts. The famed Absalom Station parade begins at Kuthona's end and continues into Abadius, but Newspark has no fixed date.
